clips.title: The story
paras: In the Barrens, Savannah Lion Tusks go from hunting trophies to ingredients in Chen Stormstout's legendary potent ale.

The great cats roaming the Barrens carry sharp, heavy tusks. Prowlers, huntresses, prides ruled by patriarchs, and beasts like Humar the Pridelord all bear them. Travelers often take the teeth as proof of a successful hunt. Brewmaster Drohn in Ratchet uses the tusks with plainstrider kidneys and thunder lizard horns to recreate Chen Stormstout's famous namesake brew, a potent ale with a legendary kick few mortal gullets can withstand.
